QUOTE: "`allow` is checked only in `check_approval`. Neither list is checked in the other place." and "the permission lists alone don't [decide whether a call runs]" with the flow showing `auto_ok = permissions.auto_approve OR is_allowed(...)` inside `check_approval` at `tool_executor.cpp:161`, while `ServerManager::execute` in `server_manager.cpp` checks only `is_denied`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says allow is consulted only in `ToolExecutor::check_approval` (`tool_executor.cpp`) and not in `ServerManager::execute` (a different file). It also describes allow as an approval-step bypass (`auto_ok`) rather than an execution grant, since deny is checked separately at execute.
